_comment: Project-local MCP server configuration. Lives at tools/mcp.json. Referenced from agent.yaml as 'tools/mcp.json#<key>'. For desktop-wide servers shared across agents, use the global catalog (Add-ons → MCP) instead.

_example_stdio_server._comment: stdio server — Agent Studio launches this as a process.

_example_sse_server._comment: SSE server — already running, Agent Studio connects to its URL. IMPORTANT: from inside the agent's Docker sandbox, 'localhost' is the container itself, not the host. Use host.docker.internal to reach services running on the host machine.

_example_other_agent._comment: Another Agent Studio agent exposed as an MCP server. Get this URL from the target agent's Connect dialog. Always use host.docker.internal, not localhost.
